CustomField.label: Kundansatisfaction
CustomField.description: Kundansatisfaction-Score 1-5 beim Schliessen eines Service-Case (SCRUM-442). 1 = sehr dissatisfied, 5 = sehr satisfied. Pflicht beim Schliessen via ValidationRule Customer_Satisfaction_PflichtBeiClosed (NOT via required-Flag: open Cases stay voluntary). Picklist, not Number (ADR-2): platform rejects 0/6/3.5. Internal, subjective evaluation — sensitive, never to the customer or an external party.
